normative_extracts.quote: yield() returns a promise that resolves after yielding control to the event loop, preserving current task priority and inheritance.

browser_support.notes: Feature-detect 'scheduler' in globalThis && 'yield' in scheduler; fall back to setTimeout(0) or MessageChannel.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: scheduler.yield() suspends an async task and places its continuation in a priority-inherited continuation queue ahead of normal third-party tasks.

production_failures.symptom: Yielding with setTimeout(fn, 0) delays hydration by 400ms on ad-heavy pages
production_failures.root_cause: setTimeout(0) sends the continuation to the back of the macrotask queue behind third-party analytics and ad scripts, and incurs 4ms clamping after 5 nested calls.
production_failures.mitigation: Use scheduler.yield() where supported so first-party continuations resume ahead of unrelated background tasks.

production_failures.symptom: Unconditional yield() inside a tight 100k-item loop slows total completion by 10x
production_failures.root_cause: Yielding on every iteration pays a full event loop round-trip per item instead of batching work up to a 5ms-16ms frame budget.
production_failures.mitigation: Check navigator.scheduling?.isInputPending() or elapsed performance.now() >= 16 before awaiting scheduler.yield().
